subsection: H. Directors and Officers Liability (D&O) Insurance
text: Federal Ins. Co. (1990) 219 CA3d 252, 258, 268 CR 90, 92 (emphasis added; original emphasis omitted)] 3. [3:647] Coverage Analysis for Employment-Related Claims: The following are the primary issues in determining coverage for claims under D&O policies: a. [3:648] “Wrongful acts”: The term “wrongful act” is usually defined in the policy to include actual or alleged errors or omissions, neglect or breach of duty, and misleading statements, including some forms of intentional conduct. (1) [3:648.1] Does not include breach of contract: An insured's failure to pay amounts due under a contract does not qualify as a “wrongful act.” Claims arising out of breach of contract thus are not covered because “there is no ‘wrongful act’ and no ‘loss’ since the insured is simply being required to pay an amount it agreed to pay.” [August Entertainment, Inc. v. Philadelphia Indemnity Ins. Co. (2007) 146 CA4th 565, 579, 52 CR3d 908, 918] b.
